callout.text: Pedestrian access is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. This is a high-level ISPS restricted facility — you cannot walk from the gangway to the checkpoint under any circumstances.

rows.title: Only by your agent's vehicle or the terminal's own shuttle
rows.sub: No exceptions, no walking any part of the route

sections.title: Before you even get in the vehicle

rows.title: Hi-vis vest, helmet and safety boots — required from the gangway
rows.sub: You will not be allowed into the agent's car without full PPE

rows.title: Shore Pass
rows.sub: Arranged by your ship's agent

rows.title: Schengen visa required for non-EU citizens

callout.text: Never exchange money on the street, even for a good rate someone offers you. In some countries this is a criminal offence — and it's one of the most common ways seafarers get scammed near a port.

klaipeda_kn_city_safety.title: Safety

callout.text: Before you leave, agree your return time with the ship and mark your ship's position on the Ship screen.

rows.title: Klaipėda is a safe European city
rows.sub: The port area and Old Town are well lit and patrolled

rows.title: Stay off closed private and industrial land beyond the marked pedestrian paths
rows.sub: To avoid being stopped by police or port (ISPS) security

rows.title: Drinking in the street, parks or on the waterfront is strictly forbidden
rows.sub: Fines of €30–100

klaipeda_kn_city_safety.note: Same city-wide information as the Passenger Terminal — confirmed by the coordinator as applying here too.
